premise: On a hot dry day Flower and Berry Bush droop; Spinosaurus comes out of the lagoon dripping and shakes himself off — wiggle, wiggle — all over them; he says sorry, but they perk right up: it was just the drink they needed.
inspiration: The cracked water pot (Indian folk parable: its leaks watered the flowers by the path), turned funny: the drips that seemed rude were a gift.
lesson: Sometimes a mistake turns out to be a gift.

en-US.title: Spinosaurus Waters the Garden
en-US.text: {flower:enter} {bush:enter} {canvas:sunshine 1} {sfx:heat} [softly] It was a hot, dry day. Not one raindrop had fallen for days and days. {flower:face sad} {flower:live droop hold} Flower drooped. {bush:face sad} {bush:wobble 0.3} Berry Bush sagged. [sighs] "So… thirsty…" Out in the lagoon, {spinosaurus:enter} {spinosaurus:go to lagoon by swim} Spinosaurus was having a lovely swim. Out he climbed, dripping wet, {spinosaurus:go to flower} and came up to say hello. {spinosaurus:face happy} "Hello, Flower!" And then he did what he always did after a swim. {spinosaurus:live shake-off} {sfx:shake} Wiggle, wiggle, SPLASH! {flower:spray} Water flew everywhere. {spinosaurus:face surprised} [nervously] "Oh! Sorry! I splashed you!" {flower:live droop resume} But Flower lifted her head, slowly, slowly… {flower:face happy} [happily] "Don't be sorry! That was just the drink I needed!" Then a tiny voice called out: "Me too, please?" {spinosaurus:go to bush} So Spinosaurus trotted over to Berry Bush, {spinosaurus:live shake-off} and wiggle, wiggle, SPLASH! {bush:spray} {bush:face happy} {bush:live perk-up} Berry Bush puffed up, tall and round and shiny. [laughs] {spinosaurus:face happy} {spinosaurus:hop} "I'll be right back," grinned Spinosaurus, "with more!" {canvas:sunshine stop}

es-ES.title: Espinosaurio riega el jardín
es-ES.text: {flower:enter} {bush:enter} {canvas:sunshine 1} {sfx:heat} [softly] Hacía un día caluroso y seco. Llevaba días y días sin caer ni una gota. {flower:face sad} {flower:live droop hold} Flor estaba mustia. {bush:face sad} {bush:wobble 0.3} Arbusto, alicaído. [sighs] —Qué… sed… En la laguna, {spinosaurus:enter} {spinosaurus:go to lagoon by swim} Espinosaurio se daba un baño estupendo. Salió chorreando {spinosaurus:go to flower} y subió a saludar. {spinosaurus:face happy} —¡Hola, Flor! Y entonces hizo lo que hacía siempre después de bañarse. {spinosaurus:live shake-off} {sfx:shake} ¡Meneo, meneo, y CHOF! {flower:spray} El agua salió volando por todas partes. {spinosaurus:face surprised} [nervously] —¡Ay! ¡Perdona! ¡Te he mojado! {flower:live droop resume} Pero Flor levantó la cabeza, despacito, despacito… {flower:face happy} [happily] —¡No pidas perdón! ¡Era justo el agua que necesitaba! Entonces se oyó una vocecita: —¿Y a mí? {spinosaurus:go to bush} Así que Espinosaurio se fue trotando hasta Arbusto, {spinosaurus:live shake-off} y meneo, meneo, ¡CHOF! {bush:spray} {bush:face happy} {bush:live perk-up} Arbusto se esponjó, alto, redondo y brillante. [laughs] {spinosaurus:face happy} {spinosaurus:hop} —¡Ahora vuelvo —dijo Espinosaurio, sonriendo— con más! {canvas:sunshine stop}
